depthConvention: black near, white far; sample red as linear unorm, matching the existing GPU depth texture
model: Piecewise world-Y ground depth, clamped outside the sampled route extent. Sprite uses the depth at its foot Y for every pixel; each trail fragment uses its own world Y.

Exposed lower road between woodland trees; original WebP 3x3 mean 63.4

biasModel: Interpolate near to original bias/feather using clamp((objectDepth*255-66)/25,0,1). The southern artistic depth range is compressed: clear road 58-66, canopy 18-44. Ground objects use the independent ground curve, never scene depth. All overlays share the same comparison, including banner surface depths; lens depth remains separate.
filter: Mean of a 3-by-3 neighborhood at two-source-pixel spacing; suppresses isolated dark and bright texture flecks before the biased comparison. Boundaries remain approximate.
limitations: Source review explicitly rejects exact occlusion. This is a conservative visual approximation: thin branches and weak depth differences remain visible, coarse depth silhouettes may not match source foliage, terrain at the same Y can have different depth, and the bridge and water retain lighting bias. No navigation or source art is changed. Canvas2D fallback reports occlusion unavailable.
